1: /* weapons.js — viewmodels procedurais, recuo, muzzle flash, hitscan, rocket spawn.
2:  * 🎨 Render: usa THREE (malhas presas à câmera) + weapons-core.js (math pura).
3:  * Disparos de projétil delegam ao módulo de projectiles via hook.
4:  */
5: import * as THREE from 'three';
6: import { C } from './constants.js';
7: import { fireReady, canFire, consumeAmmo, spreadOffset, chaingunSpread } from './weapons-core.js';
8: import { raycastWall } from './map.js';
9: 
10: const KEYS = ['1', '2', '3', '4'];
11: const NAMES = ['pistol', 'shotgun', 'chaingun', 'rocket'];
12: 
13: export function createWeapons(engine, player, scene, hooks) {
14:   let ammo = { shell: C.WEAPONS.shotgun.ammoStart, bullet: C.WEAPONS.chaingun.ammoStart, rocket: C.WEAPONS.rocket.ammoStart };
15:   let current = 0;
16:   let sinceLast = 99;
17:   let kick = 0;
18:   let muzzleT = 0;
19:   let spin = 0;
20: 
21:   const viewGroup = new THREE.Group();
22:   engine.camera.add(viewGroup);
23:   scene.add(engine.camera);
24: 
25:   const materials = {
26:     dark: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x2a2d33 }),
27:     steel: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x6a7078 }),
28:     grip: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x4a3524 }),
29:     brass: new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xb08a3a }),
30:   };
31: 
32:   function box(w, h, d, mat, x, y, z) {
33:     const m = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(w, h, d), materials[mat]);
34:     m.position.set(x, y, z);
35:     return m;
36:   }
37: 
38:   function buildViewmodel(type) {
39:     const g = new THREE.Group();
40:     if (type === 'pistol') {
41:       g.add(box(0.09, 0.13, 0.3, 'dark', 0, 0, 0));
42:       g.add(box(0.05, 0.05, 0.12, 'steel', 0, 0.08, -0.2));
43:       g.add(box(0.1, 0.06, 0.08, 'grip', -0.02, -0.09, 0.08));
44:     } else if (type === 'shotgun') {
45:       g.add(box(0.16, 0.09, 0.55, 'steel', 0, 0, 0));
46:       g.add(box(0.08, 0.09, 0.45, 'dark', 0.09, 0, -0.1));
47:       g.add(box(0.09, 0.05, 0.05, 'brass', 0, 0.07, -0.26));
48:       g.add(box(0.1, 0.12, 0.14, 'grip', -0.01, -0.13, 0.22));
49:     } else if (type === 'chaingun') {
50:       g.add(box(0.12, 0.14, 0.5, 'dark', 0, 0, 0));
51:       g.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.05, 0.05, 0.3, 6).rotateX(Math.PI / 2), materials.steel)).position.set(0, 0.05, -0.25);
52:       g.add(box(0.1, 0.07, 0.12, 'grip', 0, -0.12, 0.1));
53:     } else {
54:       g.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.07, 0.07, 0.5, 8).rotateX(Math.PI / 2), materials.dark));
55:       g.add(new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(0.09, 0.14, 6).rotateX(Math.PI / 2), materials.steel)).position.set(0, 0, -0.3);
56:       g.add(box(0.02, 0.2, 0.12, 'steel', 0.09, 0, 0.1));
57:       g.add(box(0.02, 0.2, 0.12, 'steel', -0.09, 0, 0.1));
58:       g.add(box(0.1, 0.08, 0.1, 'grip', 0, -0.13, 0.18));
59:     }
60:     g.position.set(0.26, -0.24, -0.45);
61:     return g;
62:   }
63: 
64:   const viewmodels = NAMES.map((n) => {
65:     const g = buildViewmodel(n);
66:     g.visible = false;
67:     viewGroup.add(g);
68:     return g;
69:   });
70:   viewmodels[0].visible = true;
71: 
72:   const muzzle = new THREE.Mesh(
73:     new THREE.SphereGeometry(0.06, 6, 6),
74:     new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xffcc55, transparent: true, opacity: 0.9 }),
75:   );
76:   muzzle.visible = false;
77:   viewGroup.add(muzzle);
78: 
79:   const camDir = () => {
80:     const e = new THREE.Euler(camera.rotation.x, camera.rotation.y, 0, 'YXZ');
81:     const q = new THREE.Quaternion().setFromEuler(e);
82:     const v = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, -1).applyQuaternion(q);
83:     return v;
84:   };
85: 
86:   const camera = engine.camera;
87: 
88:   function hitscanDamage(w, count = 1) {
89:     const dir = camDir();
90:     const origin = { x: camera.position.x, y: camera.position.y, z: camera.position.z };
91:     for (let i = 0; i < count; i++) {
92:       const s = spreadOffset(chaingunSpread(w.spread, spin));
93:       const dx = dir.x + dir.x * s.a - dir.z * s.b;
94:       const dz = dir.z + dir.z * s.a + dir.x * s.b;
95:       const wallDist = raycastWall(hooks.map, origin.x, origin.z, dx, dz);
96:       for (const e of hooks.getEnemies()) {
97:         if (e.dead) continue;
98:         const ex = e.x - origin.x, ez = e.z - origin.z;
99:         const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (ex * dx + ez * dz)));
100:         const px = origin.x + t * dx - e.x, pz = origin.z + t * dz - e.z;
101:         if (Math.hypot(px, pz) < 0.5 && t < wallDist) {
102:           e.takeDamage(w.damage * (0.8 + Math.random() * 0.4));
103:           hooks.impact(e.x, e.y + 1, e.z);
104:         }
105:       }
106:     }
107:   }
108: 
109:   function fire() {
110:     const w = C.WEAPONS[NAMES[current]];
111:     if (!canFire(w, ammo)) { hooks.noAmmo(); return; }
112:     if (!fireReady(w, sinceLast)) return;
113:     sinceLast = 0;
114:     ammo = consumeAmmo(w, ammo);
115:     kick = Math.min(1, kick + (w.rate < 0.15 ? 0.12 : 0.5));
116:     muzzleT = 0.045;
117:     if (current === 0) spin = 0;
118:     else spin = Math.min(1, spin + 0.25);
119:     hooks.shoot();
120:     if (NAMES[current] === 'rocket') {
121:       const dir = camDir();
122:       hooks.spawnProjectile({ x: camera.position.x + dir.x * 0.8, y: camera.position.y - 0.1, z: camera.position.z + dir.z * 0.8 }, dir);
123:     } else {
124:       hitscanDamage(w, NAMES[current] === 'shotgun' ? w.pellets : 1);
125:     }
126:   }
127: 
128:   function select(i) {
129:     if (i === current) return;
130:     current = i;
131:     viewmodels.forEach((g, k) => { g.visible = k === i; });
132:     kick = 0.3;
133:   }
134: 
135:   function update(dt) {
136:     sinceLast += dt;
137:     if (muzzleT > 0) {
138:       muzzleT -= dt;
139:       muzzle.visible = true;
140:       muzzle.position.set(0.02, 0.02, -0.62);
141:     } else muzzle.visible = false;
142: 
143:     kick = Math.max(0, kick - dt * 3.2);
144:     for (const g of viewmodels) {
145:       if (!g.visible) continue;
146:       g.position.z = -0.45 + kick * 0.28;
147:       g.position.y = -0.24 + Math.sin(player.bob * Math.PI * 2) * 0.008;
148:       g.rotation.x = kick * 0.25;
149:       if (NAMES[current] === 'chaingun') {
150:         g.rotation.z = Math.sin(performance.now() * 0.05) * 0.02;
151:       }
152:     }
153:     for (let i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
154:       if (engine.wasPressed(KEYS[i])) select(i);
155:     }
156:     if (engine.input.scroll !== 0) {
157:       select((current + (engine.input.scroll > 0 ? 1 : 3)) % 4);
158:     }
159:     if (engine.input.keys.has('Mouse0')) fire();
160:   }
161: 
162:   return {
163:     get ammo() { return ammo; },
164:     get current() { return current; },
165:     get name() { return NAMES[current]; },
166:     update,
167:     fire,
168:     select,
169:     getViewmodel: () => viewmodels[current],
170:   };
171: }
172: 
173: export default createWeapons;

1: import test from 'node:test';
2: import assert from 'node:assert/strict';
3: import { C } from '../js/constants.js';
4: import {
5:   splashDamage, selfSplashDamage, spreadOffset, chaingunSpread,
6:   fireReady, canFire, consumeAmmo, pickupAmmo, zombieDamage,
7: } from '../js/weapons-core.js';
8: 
9: test('splash falloff: dmg*(1-d/radius)+1 com mínimo 1', () => {
10:   const w = C.WEAPONS.rocket;
11:   assert.ok(Math.abs(splashDamage(w, 0) - (w.damage + 1)) < 1e-9, 'centro = dmg+1');
12:   assert.ok(Math.abs(splashDamage(w, w.splash) - 1) < 1e-9, 'borda = 1');
13:   assert.ok(Math.abs(splashDamage(w, w.splash / 2) - (w.damage * 0.5 + 1)) < 1e-9, 'meio = dmg/2+1');
14:   assert.equal(splashDamage(w, w.splash * 2), 1, 'fora do raio = 1');
15:   // monotônico decrescente
16:   let prev = Infinity;
17:   for (let d = 0; d <= w.splash + 0.5; d += 0.25) {
18:     const v = splashDamage(w, d);
19:     assert.ok(v <= prev + 1e-9, `falloff deve ser não-crescente em d=${d}`);
20:     prev = v;
21:   }
22: });
23: 
24: test('self splash: aplica fração selfDamage', () => {
25:   const w = C.WEAPONS.rocket;
26:   const d = selfSplashDamage(w, 0);
27:   assert.ok(Math.abs(d - (w.damage + 1) * w.selfDamage) < 1e-9, 'auto-dano = 0.5x');
28: });
29: 
30: test('spread: offsets dentro de [-spread, spread]', () => {
31:   for (let i = 0; i < 1000; i++) {
32:     const { a, b } = spreadOffset(0.08);
33:     assert.ok(a >= -0.08 && a <= 0.08, `a=${a} fora do intervalo`);
34:     assert.ok(b >= -0.08 && b <= 0.08, `b=${b} fora do intervalo`);
35:   }
36: });
37: 
38: test('chaingun spread cresce com o spin', () => {
39:   const base = C.WEAPONS.chaingun.spread;
40:   assert.ok(chaingunSpread(base, 0) === base, 'spin 0 = base');
41:   assert.ok(chaingunSpread(base, 10) > base, 'spin alto aumenta spread');
42: });
43: 
44: test('cooldown gating: fireReady respeita a cadência', () => {
45:   const pistol = C.WEAPONS.pistol;
46:   assert.equal(fireReady(pistol, 0.1), false, 'abaixo da cadência');
47:   assert.equal(fireReady(pistol, 0.3), true, 'na cadência exata');
48:   assert.equal(fireReady(pistol, 0.5), true, 'acima da cadência');
49: });
50: 
51: test('canFire: pistola infinita, demais exigem munição', () => {
52:   const pistol = C.WEAPONS.pistol;
53:   const shotgun = C.WEAPONS.shotgun;
54:   assert.equal(canFire(pistol, {}), true, 'pistola sempre dispara');
55:   assert.equal(canFire(shotgun, { shell: 0 }), false, 'sem munição');
56:   assert.equal(canFire(shotgun, { shell: 1 }), true, 'com munição');
57: });
58: 
59: test('consumeAmmo: decrementa e não vai abaixo de zero', () => {
60:   const shotgun = C.WEAPONS.shotgun;
61:   const chaingun = C.WEAPONS.chaingun;
62:   const a1 = consumeAmmo(shotgun, { shell: 12 });
63:   assert.equal(a1.shell, 11, 'shotgun consome 1');
64:   const a2 = consumeAmmo(chaingun, { bullet: 0 });
65:   assert.equal(a2.bullet, 0, 'não negativa');
66:   const a3 = consumeAmmo(C.WEAPONS.pistol, { shell: 5 });
67:   assert.equal(a3.shell, 5, 'pistola não consome');
68: });
69: 
70: test('pickupAmmo: coleta com teto e reporta ganho', () => {
71:   const shotgun = C.WEAPONS.shotgun;
72:   const r1 = pickupAmmo('shell', { shell: 30 }, 8, shotgun.ammoMax);
73:   assert.equal(r1.ammo.shell, 32, 'teto respeitado');
74:   assert.equal(r1.gained, 2, 'ganho limitado pelo teto');
75:   const r2 = pickupAmmo('bullet', { bullet: 0 }, 40, C.WEAPONS.chaingun.ammoMax);
76:   assert.equal(r2.ammo.bullet, 40);
77:   assert.equal(r2.gained, 40);
78: });
79: 
80: test('zombieDamage: dentro de [3,8]', () => {
81:   for (let i = 0; i < 200; i++) {
82:     const d = zombieDamage();
83:     assert.ok(d >= 3 && d <= 8, `dano ${d} fora de [3,8]`);
84:   }
85: });
